title: ThinQuant: Scalable Rotation Learning for Weight and Activation Quantization of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.36120v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned rotations play an important role in enabling low-bit weight and activation quantization of large language models by smoothing outliers in the activation distribution. State-of-the-art approaches include gradient-based procedures such as SpinQuant and computationally friendlier gradient-free approaches such as DartQuant, but both remain hard to scale to the largest architectures. To address the computational bottlenecks in gradient-free rotation learning, we introduce two ideas for efficiency, (i) a data selection procedure which reduces the required number of calibration data points, and (ii) an exact reduction of the associated optimization on this reduced calibration set. Our data selection procedure exploits the geometric structure of the convex hull of the activations. translated_title: ThinQuant：面向大语言模型权重与激活量化的可扩展旋转学习
translated_abstract: 学习到的旋转通过平滑激活分布中的离群值，在实现大语言模型低比特权重与激活量化方面发挥着重要作用。现有最先进的方法包括基于梯度的方法（如 SpinQuant）和计算上更友好的无梯度方法（如 DartQuant），但两者都难以扩展到最大规模的架构。为了解决无梯度旋转学习中的计算瓶颈，我们提出了两个提升效率的思路：（i）一种数据选择方法，可减少所需的校准数据点数量；（ii）在该缩减后的校准集上对相关优化问题的精确化简。我们的数据选择方法利用了激活值凸包的几何结构。借助这一思路，我们证明了精心选择的校准集仅需比最先进的基于旋转的方法少几个数量级的激活数据……（摘要原文在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: ThinQuant 通过利用激活值凸包的几何结构进行数据选择，并在缩减后的校准集上对优化问题进行精确化简，大幅降低了无梯度旋转学习的计算成本，使低比特权重与激活量化能够扩展到最大规模的大语言模型。
en_tdlr: ThinQuant makes gradient-free rotation learning scalable to the largest LLMs by exploiting the geometric structure of activation convex hulls to select calibration data and exactly reducing the resulting optimization, enabling efficient low-bit weight and activation quantization.
